Great content but frustrating scheduling software. Been subscribing for a few years now and love the content provided, within the app even though I don’t use it, as much as I should. 

Although the trainer videos and content of other areas are excellent, there is a frustrating feature that, if improved would really improve the user experience of this app...in my opinion.

Scheduling sessions is one of them. Unless there is something I haven’t learned yet, you have to schedule them one-by-one, for each day that you want to be reminded of a session. I suggested a couple years ago that the app be updated to allow users to create their own work-out program, with the videos they enjoy watching the most, I.e. if I want the to do the same video each morning and another M, W, F in the evening, then allow user to schedule the video to watch for a “range” of days or multiple days at a time vs having to schedule them one-by-one, each day you want to watch it. This provides user the latitude of creating their own program with their favorite or new videos from multiple trainers, if they want.

Lastly, about a week ago, my Grokker app won’t load my calendar. Keeps giving me an error msg. The website calendar is still visible so not sure what happened to that. I sent a message to the customer support email but never heard back. Frustrating......

Other than the above, really do enjoy the content and trainers that Grokker has partnered with.
